question: How should the written armor be prepared and worn as a protective amulet?
premises: The armor should be written on birch bark.
It should be made into an amulet placed in gold.
If so prepared, it should be worn.
inference: Writing the armor on birch bark, encasing it in gold, and wearing it constitutes the amulet practice.
plain_english: If one writes it on birch bark, makes an amulet placed in gold, one should wear it.
